{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|force]] that laid [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Sellasas]]. The commander set as the operation's goal the elimination of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] presence on the world even at the expense of massive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
